verses.he: וַיַּ֖עַן יְהוָ֥ה אֶת־אִיּ֗וֹב וַיֹּאמַֽר׃
verses.en: Moreover the LORD answered Job, and said:

verses.he: הֲ֭רֹב עִם־שַׁדַּ֣י יִסּ֑וֹר מוֹכִ֖יחַ אֱל֣וֹהַּ יַעֲנֶֽנָּה׃
verses.en: Shall he that reproveth contend with the Almighty? He that argueth with God, let him answer it.

verses.he: וַיַּ֖עַן אִיּ֥וֹב אֶת־יְהוָ֗ה וַיֹּאמַֽר׃
verses.en: Then Job answered the LORD, and said:

verses.he: הֵ֣ן קַ֭לֹּתִי מָ֣ה אֲשִׁיבֶ֑ךָּ יָ֝דִ֗י שַׂ֣מְתִּי לְמוֹ־פִֽי׃
verses.en: Behold, I am of small account; what shall I answer Thee? I lay my hand upon my mouth.

verses.he: אַחַ֣ת דִּ֭בַּרְתִּי וְלֹ֣א אֶֽעֱנֶ֑ה וּ֝שְׁתַּ֗יִם וְלֹ֣א אוֹסִֽיף׃
verses.en: Once have I spoken, but I will not answer again; Yea, twice, but I will proceed no further.

verses.he: וַיַּֽעַן־יְהוָ֣ה אֶת־אִ֭יּוֹב מן סערה [מִ֥ן׀ סְעָרָ֗ה] וַיֹּאמַֽר׃
verses.en: Then the LORD answered Job out of the whirlwind, and said:

verses.he: אֱזָר־נָ֣א כְגֶ֣בֶר חֲלָצֶ֑יךָ אֶ֝שְׁאָלְךָ֗ וְהוֹדִיעֵֽנִי׃
verses.en: Gird up thy loins now like a man; I will demand of thee, and declare thou unto Me. .

verses.he: הַ֭אַף תָּפֵ֣ר מִשְׁפָּטִ֑י תַּ֝רְשִׁיעֵ֗נִי לְמַ֣עַן תִּצְדָּֽק׃
verses.en: Wilt thou even make void My judgment? Wilt thou condemn Me, that thou mayest be justified?

verses.he: וְאִם־זְר֖וֹעַ כָּאֵ֥ל׀ לָ֑ךְ וּ֝בְק֗וֹל כָּמֹ֥הוּ תַרְעֵֽם׃
verses.en: Or hast thou an arm like God? And canst thou thunder with a voice like Him?

verses.he: עֲדֵ֥ה נָ֣א גָֽא֣וֹן וָגֹ֑בַהּ וְה֖וֹד וְהָדָ֣ר תִּלְבָּֽשׁ׃
verses.en: Deck thyself now with majesty and excellency, And array thyself with glory and beauty.

verses.he: הָ֭פֵץ עֶבְר֣וֹת אַפֶּ֑ךָ וּרְאֵ֥ה כָל־גֵּ֝אֶ֗ה וְהַשְׁפִּילֵֽהוּ׃
verses.en: Cast abroad the rage of thy wrath; And look upon every one that is proud, and abase him.

verses.he: רְאֵ֣ה כָל־גֵּ֭אֶה הַכְנִיעֵ֑הוּ וַהֲדֹ֖ךְ רְשָׁעִ֣ים תַּחְתָּֽם׃
verses.en: Look on every one that is proud, and bring him low; And tread down the wicked in their place.

verses.he: טָמְנֵ֣ם בֶּעָפָ֣ר יָ֑חַד פְּ֝נֵיהֶ֗ם חֲבֹ֣שׁ בַּטָּמֽוּן׃
verses.en: Hide them in the dust together; Bind their faces in the hidden place.

verses.he: וְגַם־אֲנִ֥י אוֹדֶ֑ךָּ כִּֽי־תוֹשִׁ֖עַ לְךָ֣ יְמִינֶֽךָ׃
verses.en: Then will I also confess unto thee That thine own right hand can save thee.

verses.he: הִנֵּה־נָ֣א בְ֭הֵמוֹת אֲשֶׁר־עָשִׂ֣יתִי עִמָּ֑ךְ חָ֝צִ֗יר כַּבָּקָ֥ר יֹאכֵֽל׃
verses.en: Behold now behemoth, which I made with thee; He eateth grass as an ox.

verses.he: הִנֵּה־נָ֣א כֹח֣וֹ בְמָתְנָ֑יו וְ֝אֹנ֗וֹ בִּשְׁרִירֵ֥י בִטְנֽוֹ׃
verses.en: Lo now, his strength is in his loins, And his force is in the stays of his body.

verses.he: יַחְפֹּ֣ץ זְנָב֣וֹ כְמוֹ־אָ֑רֶז גִּידֵ֖י פחדו [פַחֲדָ֣יו] יְשֹׂרָֽגוּ׃
verses.en: He straineth his tail like a cedar; The sinews of his thighs are knit together.

verses.he: עֲ֭צָמָיו אֲפִיקֵ֣י נְחוּשָׁ֑ה גְּ֝רָמָ֗יו כִּמְטִ֥יל בַּרְזֶֽל׃
verses.en: His bones are as pipes of brass; His gristles are like bars of iron.

verses.he: ה֖וּא רֵאשִׁ֣ית דַּרְכֵי־אֵ֑ל הָ֝עֹשׂוֹ יַגֵּ֥שׁ חַרְבּֽוֹ׃
verses.en: He is the beginning of the ways of God; He only that made him can make His sword to approach unto him.

verses.he: כִּֽי־ב֭וּל הָרִ֣ים יִשְׂאוּ־ל֑וֹ וְֽכָל־חַיַּ֥ת הַ֝שָּׂדֶ֗ה יְשַֽׂחֲקוּ־שָֽׁם׃
verses.en: Surely the mountains bring him forth food, And all the beasts of the field play there.

verses.he: תַּֽחַת־צֶאֱלִ֥ים יִשְׁכָּ֑ב בְּסֵ֖תֶר קָנֶ֣ה וּבִצָּֽה׃
verses.en: He lieth under the lotus-trees, In the covert of the reed, and fens.

verses.he: יְסֻכֻּ֣הוּ צֶאֱלִ֣ים צִֽלֲל֑וֹ יְ֝סֻבּ֗וּהוּ עַרְבֵי־נָֽחַל׃
verses.en: The lotus-trees cover him with their shadow; The willows of the brook compass him about.

verses.he: הֵ֤ן יַעֲשֹׁ֣ק נָ֭הָר לֹ֣א יַחְפּ֑וֹז יִבְטַ֓ח׀ כִּֽי־יָגִ֖יחַ יַרְדֵּ֣ן אֶל־פִּֽיהוּ׃
verses.en: Behold, if a river overflow, he trembleth not; He is confident, though the Jordan rush forth to his mouth.

verses.he: בְּעֵינָ֥יו יִקָּחֶ֑נּוּ בְּ֝מֽוֹקְשִׁ֗ים יִנְקָב־אָֽף׃
verses.en: Shall any take him by his eyes, Or pierce through his nose with a snare?

verses.he: תִּמְשֹׁ֣ךְ לִוְיָתָ֣ן בְּחַכָּ֑ה וּ֝בְחֶ֗בֶל תַּשְׁקִ֥יעַ לְשֹׁנֽוֹ׃
verses.en: Canst thou draw out leviathan with a fish-hook? Or press down his tongue with a cord?

verses.he: הֲתָשִׂ֣ים אַגְמ֣וֹן בְּאַפּ֑וֹ וּ֝בְח֗וֹחַ תִּקּ֥וֹב לֶֽחֱיוֹ׃
verses.en: Canst thou put a ring into his nose? Or bore his jaw through with a hook?

verses.he: הֲיַרְבֶּ֣ה אֵ֭לֶיךָ תַּחֲנוּנִ֑ים אִם־יְדַבֵּ֖ר אֵלֶ֣יךָ רַכּֽוֹת׃
verses.en: Will he make many supplications unto thee? Or will he speak soft words unto thee?

verses.he: הֲיִכְרֹ֣ת בְּרִ֣ית עִמָּ֑ךְ תִּ֝קָּחֶ֗נּוּ לְעֶ֣בֶד עוֹלָֽם׃
verses.en: Will he make a covenant with thee, That thou shouldest take him for a servant for ever?

verses.he: הַֽתְשַׂחֶק־בּ֖וֹ כַּצִּפּ֑וֹר וְ֝תִקְשְׁרֶ֗נּוּ לְנַעֲרוֹתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.en: Wilt thou play with him as with a bird? Or wilt thou bind him for thy maidens? .

verses.he: יִכְר֣וּ עָ֭לָיו חַבָּרִ֑ים יֶ֝חֱצ֗וּהוּ בֵּ֣ין כְּֽנַעֲנִֽים׃
verses.en: Will the bands of fishermen make a banquet of him? Will they part him among the merchants?

verses.he: הַֽתְמַלֵּ֣א בְשֻׂכּ֣וֹת עוֹר֑וֹ וּבְצִלְצַ֖ל דָּגִ֣ים רֹאשֽׁוֹ׃
verses.en: Canst thou fill his skin with barbed irons? Or his head with fish-spears?

verses.he: שִׂים־עָלָ֥יו כַּפֶּ֑ךָ זְכֹ֥ר מִ֝לְחָמָ֗ה אַל־תּוֹסַֽף׃
verses.en: Lay thy hand upon him; Think upon the battle, thou wilt do so no more.
